acceptances.rationale: Mission Control uses React Router declarative client routing and constructs navigation targets from internal route maps. No attacker-controlled path is passed to React Router navigation.

acceptances.rationale: The affected error deserialization path is specific to Framework/Data Router SSR hydration. Mission Control is a Vite client-only application using declarative BrowserRouter and does not hydrate server-produced router errors.
controls: runtime contract and browser route tests
